summary: fix(pagination): walk 0-based pages from the spec default instead of skipping page 1 (issue #12)
reason: Fiken's list endpoints declare `page` with default 0, so the cursor-less first request is served page 0 and the next page is 1. The printed page-int fallback in internal/cli/sync.go (syncResource and its copy in syncDependentResource) did `strconv.Atoi(cursor)` on the empty first cursor, clamped the result up to 1 and requested page 2, so page 1 of every paginated resource was never fetched: accounts landed 477 of 577 rows, journal_entries 100 of 163, in every company. Independently, internal/cli/helpers.go's paginatedGet only advanced offset-type pagination in its bare-array branch (nextFullPageOffsetCursor), and Fiken answers with bare arrays, so `--all` returned the first page and stopped. The fix keys the 0-based walk on the spec default rather than on a Fiken-specific branch: paginationDefaults gains a `firstPage` field that determinePaginationDefaults sets to the spec's `page` default (0), both sync.go fallbacks read the empty cursor as firstPage and advance current+1 (a short page still ends the loop), paginatedGet gains nextFullPagePageCursor as a page-type sibling of nextFullPageOffsetCursor, and nextClientSidePaginationCursor's unset-page default becomes the same spec default instead of the hard-coded 1. On a 1-based API the same code is correct once firstPage is printed as 1. Every company needs a full resync after this lands.
call_sites: func nextFullPagePageCursor(params map[string]string, cursorParam, paginationType, limitParam string, itemCount int) (string, bool) {
validated_outcome: make check green (go vet ./..., go test ./..., scripts/check-boundaries.sh). Hand-authored tests in internal/cli/pagination_zero_based_test.go drive a httptest server serving 250 rows at page size 100 as bare JSON arrays: TestSyncResource_WalksZeroBasedPagesFromPageZero and TestSyncDependentResource_WalksZeroBasedPagesFromPageZero land 250 rows over pages <absent>,1,2 with page 1 requested exactly once; TestPaginatedGet_AllFollowsBareArrayPages returns 250 items over pages 0,1,2. Reverted-behaviour check: the same tests report 150 rows and 100 items on the pre-patch code. No live API call was made.
